author: CNET
description:
Samsung isn't the only one coming out with a foldable phone this year. The launch of Apple's anticipated iPhone Fold is coming closer, but will it be worth the price? CNET editor at large Bridget Carey runs though what Apple can learn from Samsung regarding the foldable phone market on this weeks episode of One More Thing. 

Full video coming 7/24 at 8am ET on YouTube.
